notes: Diskless Game Fix is now links you write yourself. The six built-in launchers are gone: their folders were guesses, and a link to a folder a launcher no longer reads is a fix that reports a tick and changes nothing. Add a launcher, give it a name, say where it is saved on the game disk, and add one Source folder per place it keeps its records — Riot needs two. Press Copy a prompt for an AI and paste the question into any assistant to find those folders. A link that moves now takes the records with it. Also: a fresh install now starts pointed at a counter on this same machine (http://localhost:8088); clear the address on the Server tab for a standalone shop.
